subject.title: Bug: Poe image/video-output models are accepted in config but fail at runtime (Nano Banana 400, Veo/Sora fallback)

question: Should OpenClaw treat media-output provider models as unsupported chat/session models with explicit rejection, or add a first-class output-modality contract that can route image/video outputs through session runtime?
rationale: Current code and docs separate chat model routing from image/video generation tools, and adding generic output modality metadata would create a new provider/config/plugin contract.

options.title: Reject Media Output In Chat
options.body: Keep session runtime text-output-only and add clear validation/fallback diagnostics plus docs pointing to image_generate and video_generate.

options.title: Design Session Media Outputs
options.body: Add output modality metadata, response handling, and channel rendering for image/video-producing session models as a larger feature.

options.title: Docs Only
options.body: Document the limitation without runtime rejection, accepting that users may still configure misleading custom provider refs.

recommendation.title: Reject Media Output In Chat
recommendation.body: Keep session runtime text-output-only and add clear validation/fallback diagnostics plus docs pointing to image_generate and video_generate.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses the model-selection and media-generation boundaries where steipete has the broadest recent history signal.
